UI wireframe/mockup appearing in the "Description" section, under "Customer Journey", illustrating the screen flow Tom follows to log into the Globy portal and subscribe to the Geolocation API packaged offer. Titled "Ordering Screen Flow" in the image itself.

Four numbered steps, each a mocked-up browser/app screen:

- **Step1 — "Globy Welcome"**: a landing screen with two buttons, "Identify Yourself" and "Create your Account". A red arrow shows the flow proceeding from "Identify Yourself" to Step2.
- **Step2 — "Identify Yourself"**: a login form with fields "E-mail" (prefilled `tom.hatto@Countrytour.com`) and "Firstname" (masked), plus "Cannot Connect?", "Cancel", and "Submit" buttons. The red arrow leads from "Submit" to Step3.
- **Step3 — "Welcome Contry-Tour Partner: 02/02/2025"**: a profile/dashboard screen showing:
  - Logged in as: Name = Tom, Last Name = Hatto, Entreprise = Country Tour, Profession = Developer, Email = tom.hatto@Countrytour.com, Id = CT-DEV-12345.
  - Partner Information: Company Name = Country Tour, Client Type = Developer Partner, Address = 10 Rue des plantes, Paris, France, VAT-Number = FRXX999999999, Acting on behalf of = Country Tour, Role = Authorized Representative.
  - Integrated Applications: Application Name = Zone Deals.
  - Available APIs: checkboxes for "Geolocation API" (checked) and "Other API" (unchecked).
  - "Cancel" and "Next" buttons, with the red arrow from "Next" leading down to Step4.
- **Step4** (untitled panel below): a package/pricing selection screen with two offer cards side by side:
  - "Belgium & France" card: Subscription fee 10€, Usage-Based fee 0.7€, Optionnal SLA fee 5€, "Terms & Conditions" checkbox (checked).
  - "Brazil" card: Subscription fee 5€, Usage-Based fee 0.4€, "Terms & Conditions" checkbox (unchecked).
  - "Cancel" and "Submit" buttons, with the red arrow looping back up to the Step3 screen's "Next" button, indicating the screens form a connected flow.

The mockup demonstrates the ordering journey end to end: identity verification, review of partner/application/API context, and selection of the commercial package (bundled Belgium & France offer vs. the Brazil offer) before submission.
